plan.title: docs: workspaces page merge and close-out
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-5502 Features accuracy audit (runs after this)
PAN-3579 CSRF bare-header mutation callers (blocks band docs)
PAN-5571 Workspaces Archived row never renders

narratives.Problem: configuration/workspaces.mdx holds the only user docs for the New workspace page, the Workspaces list, scratch and main workspaces from the CLI, close-out settings and workspace observation memory, but it is not in docs.json navigation and duplicates the 'Workspaces' title. Several of its claims are wrong against current code (Archived (N) row, Home button placement, typed destroy confirmation, fallback_chain, hitCounts, rag-decision reasons, the GitHub-pause backstop) and it omits that the closed-issue reaper deletes branches regardless of close-out settings. A link to /features/workspaces#remote-workspaces-flyio is already broken.
narratives.Proposal: Copy the verified After text from .pan/drafts/PAN-5479.md into features/workspaces.mdx (kinds, finding, creating, managing, CLI, close-out) and configuration/memory.mdx (a Workspace observation memory section with search, pins, reading back, providers, health and RAG logs), retitle both pages, fix the Remote anchor and dashes, delete the old page with a docs.json redirect, repoint reference/settings.mdx, and validate with lint:docs and mint@4.3.49 validate, broken-links and --check-anchors.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No line-by-line audit of the rest of features/workspaces.mdx; #5502 does it after this merges.
- No quick-action band docs until #3579 fixes its CSRF headers.
- No routes table for /api/workspace-registry.
- No code changes (the Archived row is #5571, CSRF callers are #3579).
- No edits to docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md, cli/workspace-commands.mdx or cli/memory-commands.mdx.
- No new screenshots, no docs.json navigation change, no changelog.d entry.
- No fixes to the three other pre-existing broken anchors (features/skills.mdx, guides/docker-setup.mdx).
- Never run mint validate --fix or mint@latest.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete configuration/workspaces.mdx, redirect /configuration/workspaces to /features/workspaces, and repoint reference/settings.mdx to the new close-out anchor.
autoDecisions.rationale: The page is unpublished and duplicates the Workspaces title; the issue asks to merge it away, and a redirect keeps any old link working.

autoDecisions.summary: Merge into features/workspaces.mdx without auditing its stale sections (.planning/, beads, Docker, hooks).
autoDecisions.rationale: #5502 explicitly audits features/workspaces.mdx after this PR merges; the stale-claim list was posted on #5502.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave the quick-action band out of the docs; keep corrected band text in the PRD Appendix A.
autoDecisions.rationale: Its Pull, Run, Save and Files requests send no CSRF header to guarded routes (tracked in #3579), so documenting those buttons would describe actions that likely fail.
It is internal API the dashboard drives; docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md keeps the developer view.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the memory content under one new '## Workspace observation memory' section before '## Previewing', retitle the memory page 'Agent memory: curated facts and workspace observations' (sidebar 'Agent Memory'), and drop its '# Project Memory' H1.
autoDecisions.rationale: The page now covers both curated facts and observation memory; 'Memory' alone would clash with 'Memory Governor' in the same nav group.

autoDecisions.summary: Rename '## Remote Workspaces (Fly.io)' to '## Remote workspaces on Fly' and fix the cli/agent-commands.mdx link.
autoDecisions.rationale: mint broken-links --check-anchors already reports #remote-workspaces-flyio as broken; a punctuation-free heading gives a predictable slug.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove every em/en dash from the four edited pages, including two lines in cli/agent-commands.mdx.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue rule: remove dashes from bodies you edit.

autoDecisions.summary: Correct every verified error from the old page instead of copying it (More menu, no Archived (N) row, destroy is issue-only with no typed confirmation, fallback_chain first entry only, hitCounts.facts, rag-decision reason rules, reaper overlap, GitHub-pause backstop).
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue rule: every claim must match current code; verification evidence is in the PRD Problem table.

autoDecisions.summary: File the dead Archived (N) row as #5571 and add the band and Cmd-K CSRF callers to #3579 instead of fixing code here.
